PJCF.description: Project Information (PJCF). A single-key record (key is always 1) holding project metadata, contact details, and the review/approval log; all fields are optional strings and unspecified fields keep their existing stored value on PUT.

FILE_NAME.description: Model file name (without extension). Read-only: derived from the saved document path on GET and ignored on PUT.

DIR.description: Model file directory. Read-only: derived from the saved document path on GET and ignored on PUT.

FILE_SIZE.description: Model file size (e.g. '12 Kbytes'). Read-only: derived from the saved file on GET and ignored on PUT.

CREATED.description: Model file created time (dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM). Read-only: derived from the saved file on GET and ignored on PUT.

MODIFIED.description: Model file modified time (dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM). Read-only: derived from the saved file on GET and ignored on PUT.

ENGINEER.description: Review log row 1 (Engineer) reviewer name. Maps to review name slot 0.

EDATE.description: Review log row 1 (Engineer) date. Maps to review date slot 0.

CHECK1.description: Review log row 2 (Checker) reviewer name. Maps to review name slot 1.

CDATE1.description: Review log row 2 (Checker) date. Maps to review date slot 1.

CHECK2.description: Review log row 3 (Checker) reviewer name. Maps to review name slot 2.

CDATE2.description: Review log row 3 (Checker) date. Maps to review date slot 2.

CHECK3.description: Review log row 4 (Checker) reviewer name. Maps to review name slot 3.

CDATE3.description: Review log row 4 (Checker) date. Maps to review date slot 3.

APPROVE.description: Review log row 5 (Approver) reviewer name. Maps to review name slot 4.

ADATE.description: Review log row 5 (Approver) date. Maps to review date slot 4.
